svg.aria-label: Chrome extensions (Price History for Amazon, Account Switcher for Reddit) and other tools (Bitcoin JS Solo Miner, Bavin).

div.p: Each one does a single job, well.
Open any Amazon product’s price history on CamelCamelCamel or Keepa in one click.
The mobile app’s account switching, right in reddit.com’s profile menu. No tracking.

div.h2: Built to understand how things work
div.p: Open-source experiments in networking and blockchain.
A working Stratum V1 miner for server CPUs, browser workers or WebGPU, with a live dashboard.
A real-time packet analyzer that shows traffic as a stacked TCP/IP protocol view.
